description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableThingFromCopyBuilder class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It tests various builder methods, including creating instances, setting attributes, features, policies, identifiers, permissions, and other properties of 'Thing' objects. The tests verify correct initialization, property updates, exception handling, and JSON serialization/deserialization behaviors.
